prompt:
The image shows face-up playing cards arranged as a hand, labeled hands, or labeled candidate cards. Use standard five-card poker ranking. Compare categories first; if categories match, use the usual rank tie-breakers with Ace high. Which candidate card makes the strongest five-card poker hand when added to the top hand?
Annotation format: set "annotation" to an array with the bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] for the selected candidate card.
Answer format: set "answer" to only the selected candidate option letter.
Example JSON:
{"annotation":[[320,300,400,420]],"answer":"B"}
